thread:
ashwin: Heads-up — kronos14b (14B) int4 canary produced repeated OOMs when handling long generations at scale.
maria: Can you paste repro steps and a small log snippet?
ashwin: Repro: spin up 4 canary pods on prod-like GPU stack, send sustained traffic with mix: 60% short (<=128) + 40% long (>=512). Failure appears after ~30–90 minutes. Snippet:
```
2026-03-20T09:04:12Z pod=canary-2 rss=10.8G req_id=zyx1 alloc=980MB max_new=800 batch=8 kv_cache=3.1G
2026-03-20T09:04:13Z oom: cudaMalloc failed device0
2026-03-20T09:04:13Z stacktrace: runtime/alloc -> kv_cache_grow -> slot_alloc
```
ashwin: Note: KV cache keeps growing after long-gen requests; RSS doesn't fully return due to fragmentation.
lee: What are the throughput figures? Any regression vs FP/integer variants?
bench-bot: Bench summary (per-GPU tokens/s):
- batch=1 max_new=128 -> 480 tok/s
- batch=4 max_new=256 -> 1,450 tok/s
- batch=8 max_new=800 -> 820 tok/s (unstable, occasional tail latency and memory spikes)
bench-bot: Full run artifacts: https://internal/bench/kronos14b/int4/2026-03-20
sophia: Quant QC: int4 passes short-form evals; for >512 token generations we see an increase in hallucination rate (~+2.4%) and some token-level entropy spikes.
maria: Proposed short-term mitigations:
  1) Reduce per-model default max_new_tokens from 1024 -> 320 to limit exposure.
  2) Enable kv slot compaction and set compaction_threshold=0.7 on canary to reclaim holes sooner.
  3) Limit default batch cap to 4 for Dedicated/Private until compaction validated.
lee: Also add an opt-in override for tenants that need long generations, gated by capacity checks (so we don't regress stability).
ashwin: Rolled a canary config patch to 2/4 pods:
```
catalog.models.kronos14b.defaults.max_new_tokens=320
runtime.kv_compactor.enabled=true
runtime.kv_compactor.compaction_threshold=0.7
runtime.batch_limits.default=4
```
ashwin: After the change (monitoring window ~5h): RSS growth flattened, no OOMs observed on patched pods, p95 latency improved ~6% on batch=4 steady-state. Batch=8 still flaky on unpatched nodes.
maria: Need to validate customer-facing quality impact due to lower default max. Sophia to run targeted long-form A/B (int4@320 vs int4@1024 vs int8@1024).
sophia: Kicked off A/B: will evaluate LM metrics + long-hallucination rate + human spot-checks. ETA ~5h. Early signal: int8 recovers several failure cases from int4 long runs.
lee: Ops: create monitor to catch sustained RSS increase >120MB/min for kronos14b group (3 windows). Also add an alert on repeated OOMs across pods.
devops-bot: Monitor rule created: kronos14b.rss_growth (threshold=120MB/min, window=3m)
devops-bot: Alert rule created: kronos14b.oom_rate (threshold=2 OOMs/10m across cluster)
ashwin: Fallback plan if quality or perf unacceptable: auto-fallback to int8 when either batch>=8 or max_new_tokens>512, keep default at int4@320 for general usage.
maria: Rollout plan: canary -> 25% Dedicated -> 100% Dedicated/Private with staged verification (monitoring + smoke eval). I'll draft the rollout PR.
ashwin: Action items:
  - [ashwin] push model-catalog PR with new defaults and runtime flags
  - [maria] own rollout plan and staged verification checklist
  - [sophia] finish A/B long-form eval and publish fail-case examples
  - [lee] implement tenant opt-in gating and routing safety checks
  - [devops-bot] keep monitors noisy until stable then lower noise
sophia: Posting interim results in 4h; will include example prompts where int4 drops and int8 recovers.
lee: If anyone sees new OOMs tag @ashwin and @maria. Keep this thread for follow-ups and final rollout sign-off.
ashwin: Thanks — will update once bench artifacts and PR are ready.
